name: Proportion
definition: The ratio of one dimension to another, and of a part to the whole. A style holds one ratio or one series of ratios through the room, the facade or the picture.

measures.reference: Modulor, tatami 91 x 182 cm, 60 cm kitchen module

sources.title: Francis D. K. Ching, Architecture: Form, Space, and Order (Wiley, 4th edition, 2014)
Le Corbusier, The Modulor (Faber and Faber, 1954)
